tools.description: Register a new collaboration session. Call this when starting work to enable coordination with other sessions.

machine_id.description: Optional machine identifier for multi-machine setups

tools.name: collab_session_start

tools.description: End a session and release all its claims.

release_claims.description: How to handle unreleased claims: complete (mark as done) or abandon

tools.name: collab_session_end

tools.description: List all active sessions. Use to see who else is working.
tools.name: collab_session_list

tools.description: Update session heartbeat to indicate the session is still active.

current_task.description: Optional: Current task being worked on

todos.description: Optional: Current todo list to sync

tools.name: collab_session_heartbeat

tools.description: Update session work status. Use this to share what you are currently working on with other sessions.

current_task.description: Description of current task (e.g., "Refactoring auth module")

tools.name: collab_status_update

tools.description: Configure session behavior for conflict handling. Settings persist for the session duration.

allow_release_others.description: Allow releasing claims from other sessions (default: false)

mode.description: Conflict handling mode: strict (always ask), smart (ask but suggest for stale), bypass (warn only)

stale_threshold_hours.description: Hours before a claim is considered stale (default: 2)

tools.name: collab_config

tools.description: Declare files or specific symbols (functions/classes) you are about to modify. Use symbols for fine-grained claims that allow other sessions to work on different parts of the same file.

files.description: File paths to claim. Supports glob patterns like 'src/api/*'. Use this for whole-file claims.

intent.description: What you plan to do with these files/symbols

priority.description: Priority (0-100). Levels: critical (90-100), high (70-89), normal (40-69, default: 50), low (0-39)

symbols.description: Symbol-level claims for fine-grained conflict detection. Use this instead of files when you only need to modify specific functions/classes.

symbol_type.description: Type of symbols being claimed (default: function)

symbols.description: Symbol names (function, class, method names) to claim

tools.name: collab_claim

tools.description: Check if files or symbols are being worked on by other sessions. ALWAYS call this before modifying files. Supports symbol-level checking for fine-grained conflict detection.

session_id.description: Your session ID (to exclude your own claims from results)

symbols.description: Symbol-level check. If provided, only checks for conflicts with these specific symbols.
Symbol names to check for conflicts

tools.name: collab_check

tools.description: Release a claim when done or abandoning work. By default you can only release your own claims. Use force=true with user confirmation to release stale claims from other sessions.

force.description: Force release even if claim belongs to another session (requires user confirmation)

session_id.description: Your session ID (required to verify ownership)

status.description: Whether work was completed or abandoned

summary.description: Optional summary of what was done (for completed claims)

tools.name: collab_release

tools.description: List all WIP claims. Use to see what files are being worked on.
tools.name: collab_claims_list

tools.description: Update the priority of an existing claim. Higher priority claims take precedence in queue ordering.

priority.description: New priority (0-100). Levels: critical (90-100), high (70-89), normal (40-69), low (0-39)

tools.name: collab_claim_update_priority

tools.description: Automatically release claims for a file after editing. Call this after Edit/Write operations to release the claim for the edited file. For small scope claims, releases immediately. For medium/large scope claims, requires force=true or auto_release_immediate config.

file_path.description: The file that was just edited

force.description: Force release even for medium/large scope claims

tools.name: collab_auto_release

tools.description: Send a message to another session or broadcast to all sessions.

to_session_id.description: Target session ID. Leave empty to broadcast to all.

tools.name: collab_message_send

tools.description: Read messages sent to your session.
tools.name: collab_message_list

tools.description: Record an architectural or design decision for team reference.

description.description: Detailed description of the decision and rationale

tools.name: collab_decision_add

tools.description: List recorded decisions. Use to understand past architectural choices.

limit.description: Maximum number of decisions to return

tools.name: collab_decision_list

tools.description:
Analyze LSP symbols for conflict detection and reference impact.

WORKFLOW:
1. Claude uses LSP.documentSymbol to get symbols from a file
2. Claude passes those symbols to this tool
3. This tool checks conflicts and returns which symbols are safe/blocked

This enables Claude to automatically proceed with safe symbols and skip blocked ones.

check_symbols.description: Optional: Only analyze these specific symbol names (filter)

files.description: Files with their LSP symbols to analyze

children.description: Nested symbols (e.g., methods in a class)

references.description: Optional: Reference data from LSP.findReferences for impact analysis
Locations that reference this symbol (from LSP.findReferences)

session_id.description: Your session ID (to exclude your own claims)

tools.name: collab_analyze_symbols

tools.description:
Validate that symbols exist in a file before claiming them.

Use this to verify symbol names are correct before calling collab_claim.
Helps prevent claiming non-existent or misspelled symbols.

file.description: File path to validate symbols in

lsp_symbols.description: LSP symbols from the file (from LSP.documentSymbol)

tools.name: collab_validate_symbols

tools.description:
Store symbol reference data from LSP.findReferences for impact tracking.

Call this after using LSP.findReferences to persist the reference data.
This enables automatic impact warnings when other sessions claim related files.

clear_existing.description: Clear existing references from this session before storing (default: false)

tools.name: collab_store_references

tools.description:
Analyze the impact of modifying a symbol.

Returns which files reference this symbol and if any of those files have active claims.
Use this before making changes to widely-used symbols.

session_id.description: Your session ID (to exclude your own claims)

tools.name: collab_impact_analysis

tools.description: List audit history entries. Useful for debugging coordination issues and understanding past actions.
tools.name: collab_history_list

tools.description: Join waiting queue for a blocked claim. Use this when you want to work on files that are currently claimed by another session.

claim_id.description: The claim ID you want to wait for

intent.description: What you plan to do when the claim becomes available

priority.description: Priority (0-100). Higher priority entries are served first. Default: 50

scope.description: Estimated scope of your work: small(<30min), medium(30min-2hr), large(>2hr)

tools.name: collab_queue_join

tools.description: Leave the waiting queue for a claim.
tools.name: collab_queue_leave

tools.description: List queue entries. View who is waiting for claims.

claim_id.description: Filter by claim ID to see who is waiting for a specific claim

session_id.description: Filter by session ID to see what claims a session is waiting for

tools.name: collab_queue_list

tools.description: List notifications for your session. Check periodically for claim releases, queue updates, and messages.
tools.name: collab_notifications_list

tools.description: Mark notifications as read.

notification_ids.description: Notification IDs to mark as read

tools.name: collab_notifications_mark_read

tools.description: Save important context to working memory. Use this to persist findings, decisions, state, or any critical information that should survive context compaction.

category.description: Category of memory: finding (discovered facts), decision (choices made), state (current status), todo (pending work), important (critical info), context (general context)

expires_at.description: Optional ISO datetime when this memory should expire (e.g., for temporary state)

key.description: Unique identifier for this memory within the category (e.g., "auth_bug_root_cause")

metadata.description: Optional additional structured data (file_path, line_number, confidence, etc.)

pinned.description: If true, this memory will always be loaded when recalling active memories.

priority.description: Priority 0-100 (default 50). Higher priority memories are more likely to be recalled.

related_claim_id.description: Optional claim ID this memory relates to

tools.name: collab_memory_save

tools.description: Recall memories from working memory. Use this to retrieve previously saved context, findings, or state.

key.description: Get a specific memory by key (optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default: all)

tools.name: collab_memory_recall

tools.description: Update an existing memory entry. Use this to modify content, priority, or other properties.

expires_at.description: New expiration time, or null to remove expiration (optional)

key.description: The key of the memory to update

tools.name: collab_memory_update

tools.description: Clear memories from working memory. Can clear by key, category, or all.

category.description: Clear all memories in a category

clear_all.description: Clear ALL memories for this session (use with caution)

key.description: Clear a specific memory by key

tools.name: collab_memory_clear

tools.description: Pin or unpin a memory. Pinned memories are always included when loading active memories.

key.description: The key of the memory to pin/unpin

pinned.description: True to pin, false to unpin

tools.name: collab_memory_pin

tools.description: Get statistics about working memory usage for this session.
tools.name: collab_memory_stats

tools.description: Get all active (pinned + high priority) memories. This is the main function for loading context that should be preserved.
tools.name: collab_memory_active

tools.description: Register a plan document for protection. Plans are automatically pinned with high priority to prevent context loss.

content_summary.description: Summary of the plan content (key points, steps)

status.description: Initial status of the plan (default: draft)

tools.name: collab_plan_register

tools.description: Update plan status. Use this to progress plan through lifecycle: draft → approved → in_progress → completed → archived

summary.description: Optional updated summary (for completed plans, describe what was achieved)

tools.name: collab_plan_update_status

tools.description: Get plan information by file path.
tools.name: collab_plan_get

tools.description: List all plans for this session.
tools.name: collab_plan_list

tools.description: Register a file created in this session for protection. Protected files will trigger warnings before deletion.

description.description: Brief description of the file purpose

tools.name: collab_file_register

tools.description: List all files created in this session.
tools.name: collab_file_list_created

tools.description: Check if a file is protected. Use this before deleting or overwriting files to prevent accidental loss.
tools.name: collab_file_check_protected

tools.description: List all protected files in this session (plans + created files).
tools.name: collab_file_list_protected
